objective: Implement fair server-owned ranked matchmaking across permanent hero L1-L20 bands and rating, without activating ranked players or producing new BUKLOD app builds.
chosenApproach: Extend existing ArenaMatchCoordinator with pure server-side bracket/cohort selection; never trust a client-provided rating, char level, item, Diamond, winner or seat. Keep bounded original queue, websocket, escrow and settlement. Update old session fixtures to match the already-required trusted rating claim; add top-level behavioral coverage required by the repository accountability gate.
selectionRationale: Current matchmaking FIFO pairs verified accounts regardless of permanent character level or Arena rating. Adding a small pure selector fixes a measurable unfair pairing and is independent of the unfinished Godot ranked client bridge.
alternativeApproaches: Standalone matchmaking microservice duplicates current trusted Node service, rejected.
Client-side rating checks allow tampering and diverge from private wallet authority, rejected.
Dynamic cross-bracket widening on wait timeout risks beginner farming and violates canonical design, rejected.
preserveBehaviors: All existing verified Node WSS auth/session restrictions and action/rate controls
Server-only escrow, idempotent refunds, Diamond ledger, abort and settle
No production/RLS/wallet writes, auth credentials or account permission changes
No new native runtime, Android application, OTA, ranked enablement or staging backend
Exact 13 hero identities and 1v1/3v3/5v5 fixed roster sizes
riskAreas: Rating-range cohorts could increase high-skill wait times but must not compromise fairness
Backend unavailable in production, this source test is not real online match proof
Private Supabase profile rating must remain verified at handshake; transport tests must continue passing
productionBaselineEvidence: Production package org.mzbministry.buklod runtime 1.3.2 remains unchanged; safe feature-only base PR #1121 head 695cef5c948cabd35404ecff8a46f5153c16bae3. This branch has no production deployment, trusted staging backend, signed APK or client registration proof.
acceptanceChecks: 1–20 bracket boundary tests, rating-spread, outlier, missing claim rejection
Existing gameplay server and real WebSocket gateway tests
Protect all release gates and no prod push
Legacy authenticated Diamond-held reattachment regression still passes with verified profile rating fixture
